SELECT 
    airport_code, 
    json_extract_string(city, '$.en') AS city_name,
    CAST(string_split(trim(coordinates, '()'), ',')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS lon,
    CAST(string_split(trim(coordinates, '()'), ',')[2] AS DOUBLE) AS lat
FROM airlines.main.airports_data
LIMIT 5;

WITH airports AS (
    SELECT 
        airport_code, 
        json_extract_string(city, '$.en') AS city_name,
        CAST(string_split(trim(coordinates, '()'), ',')[1] AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180 AS lon_rad,
        CAST(string_split(trim(coordinates, '()'), ',')[2] AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180 AS lat_rad
    FROM airlines.main.airports_data
)
SELECT 
    f.flight_id,
    a1.city_name AS dep_city,
    a2.city_name AS arr_city,
    2 * 6371 * ASIN(SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((a2.lat_rad - a1.lat_rad) / 2), 2) +
        COS(a1.lat_rad) * COS(a2.lat_rad) * POWER(SIN((a2.lon_rad - a1.lon_rad) / 2), 2)
    )) AS distance
FROM airlines.main.flights f
JOIN airports a1 ON f.departure_airport = a1.airport_code
JOIN airports a2 ON f.arrival_airport = a2.airport_code
LIMIT 5;

        END AS city2,

            POWER(SIN((CAST(substring(a2.coordinates, strpos(a2.coordinates, ',') + 1, length(a2.coordinates) - strpos(a2.coordinates, ',') - 1) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180 - CAST(substring(a1.coordinates, strpos(a1.coordinates, ',') + 1, length(a1.coordinates) - strpos(a1.coordinates, ',') - 1) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180) / 2), 2) +
            COS(CAST(substring(a1.coordinates, strpos(a1.coordinates, ',') + 1, length(a1.coordinates) - strpos(a1.coordinates, ',') - 1) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180) * COS(CAST(substring(a2.coordinates, strpos(a2.coordinates, ',') + 1, length(a2.coordinates) - strpos(a2.coordinates, ',') - 1) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180) * POWER(SIN((CAST(substring(a2.coordinates, 2, strpos(a2.coordinates, ',') - 2) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180 - CAST(substring(a1.coordinates, 2, strpos(a1.coordinates, ',') - 2) AS DOUBLE) * PI() / 180) / 2), 2)
        )) AS distance
    FROM airlines.main.flights f
    JOIN airlines.main.airports_data a1 ON f.departure_airport = a1.airport_code
    JOIN airlines.main.airports_data a2 ON f.arrival_airport = a2.airport_code
),
city_pair_avg_distance AS (

        AVG(distance) AS avg_distance

    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
distance_ranges AS (

            WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
            ELSE '6000+'
        END AS distance_range
    FROM city_pair_avg_distance
)

    COUNT(*) AS pair_count
FROM distance_ranges
GROUP BY distance_range
ORDER BY pair_count ASC
